title: Demand Intake
summary: Confirms that the demand is understood, owned and routed correctly.
when: New demand enters QSCP Data & AI

title: Portfolio / Prioritization
summary: Confirms strategic alignment, Value Pool ownership and priority where formal prioritization is needed.
when: Investment or material capacity is required

title: Architecture Triage
summary: Determines whether formal architecture review is required.
when: There is a prototype, new source, integration or shared capability

title: Responsible AI Triage
summary: Determines whether the use case requires Responsible AI assessment.
when: AI, ML, GenAI or automated decisioning may be involved

title: Architecture Review Board
summary: Approves the enterprise solution approach and confirms alignment to architecture standards.

title: Responsible AI Board
summary: Assesses AI risk, controls, accountability, transparency and human oversight.

title: Privacy & Security Review
summary: Confirms privacy, identity, access, cybersecurity and data-protection requirements.

title: Delivery Readiness
summary: Confirms the scope, team, backlog, estimate and dependencies are ready for implementation.
when: A solution is about to enter delivery

title: Operational Readiness
summary: Confirms monitoring, support, ownership and service-management arrangements before production.
when: A new or materially changed product will go live

title: Go-Live Decision
summary: Confirms that the business, product and technical owners accept the production release.

title: Value Review
summary: Reviews realized value and determines whether to scale, improve, maintain or retire.
when: After sufficient adoption and usage data is available
